Roles & Responsibilities
Forklift Operator Needed!
Singaporeans Only | Up to $2,400 + OT | Pioneer | MNC | Immediate Hiring
We are seeking a Warehouse Assistant with a valid forklift license to support daily warehouse and inventory operations at an established MNC.
Salary: $2,200 – $2,400 + Overtime Pay
Location: Pioneer, Singapore
Key Responsibilities
Receive, inspect and verify incoming goods.
Perform picking, packing and stock movement.
Handle goods receiving, issuing and inventory updates.
Operate forklift safely when required.
Maintain warehouse cleanliness and safety standards.
Requirements
Valid forklift licence is mandatory.
Physically fit and able to perform warehouse duties.
Basic computer literacy.
Candidates who can start immediately are preferred.
We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
Charterhouse Resources Pte Ltd (EA Lic No: 13C6338)

About the Company
CHARTERHOUSE RESOURCES PTE. LTD.  is a boutique executive search firm with footprints in Asia, Australasia and the Middle East. We offer professional and bespoke contingency and retained search services across a variety of industrial sectors.
Recruitment is a people-focused business – our success and growth are reliant upon our people. Our team of consultants offers a blend of international recruitment experience, coupled with a platform of local market and industry knowledge. The development and success of our team requires continued focus, and we ensure that the latest market data, trends and information are at their fingertips. Performance and industry training is also regularly provided, and naturally the rigorous development of strong networks is vital to help us deliver the highest level of service for our clients.
